definitions.active_lane_duty: sum of measured enabled/active lane-cycles divided by physical lanes * wall cycles, with issue/execute stage specified
definitions.busy_duty: measured resource busy cycles / full hardware interval; must define busy and count union of active cycles
definitions.conditional_source_bound: optimistic inequality tied to exact resource/mapping/endpoint assumptions, neither prediction nor RTL measurement
definitions.full_wall_utilization: useful Matrix MAC / (4096 * full launch-to-terminal hardware cycles)
definitions.host_seconds: software elapsed time only; never utilization denominator
definitions.mac: one multiply-accumulate = one MAC, not2 FLOPs
definitions.matrix_issue_duty: cycles with accepted wide issue / same full hardware interval; not pipeline busy duty
definitions.missing: null means absent/unestablished; no numeric zero implied
definitions.software_ticks: handshake/state-machine steps which may enclose arbitrary synchronous host arithmetic; never hardware cycles
